# IMPERIA COLD WAR — OPEC 1970 (start, clock, members, calendar, President and Secretary General).
# Generated by Claude outputs/COLDWAR_OPEC_generator/build.py (do not edit by hand).

# Any scope. Calendar from the start epoch (1 Jan 1970, 365-day years): temp cwop_t_y, cwop_t_doy (0 = 1 Jan), cwop_t_ystart.
COLDWAR_OPEC_calendar_now = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_d = global.num_days }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwop_t_d = global.cwop_epoch }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_d min = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_doy = cwop_t_d }
	modulo_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_doy value = 365 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_y = cwop_t_d }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwop_t_y = cwop_t_doy }
	divide_temp_variable = { cwop_t_y = 365 }
	round_temp_variable = cwop_t_y
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_ystart = cwop_t_y }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_ystart = 365 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_ystart = global.cwop_epoch }
}

# Any scope. temp cwop_t_next = num_days of the next 1 January.
COLDWAR_OPEC_next_jan1 = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_calendar_now = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_next = cwop_t_ystart }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_next = 365 }
}

# Any scope. temp cwop_t_next = num_days of the next ordinary Conference (1 June or 1 December, Statute Art. 12).
COLDWAR_OPEC_next_session_day = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_calendar_now = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_next = cwop_t_ystart }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_doy < 151 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_next = 151 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_doy < 334 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_next = 334 }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_next = 516 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Order in the rotation of the President and the temperament of the delegation.
COLDWAR_OPEC_set_country_data = {
	# order of the President of the Conference: the founders and the members of 1970 in the order of accession, later members after them
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cwop_rank } }
		if = {
			limit = { original_tag = PER }
			set_variable = { cwop_rank = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = IRQ }
			set_variable = { cwop_rank = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = KUW }
			set_variable = { cwop_rank = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = SAU }
			set_variable = { cwop_rank = 4 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = VEN }
			set_variable = { cwop_rank = 5 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = QAT }
			set_variable = { cwop_rank = 6 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = IND }
			set_variable = { cwop_rank = 7 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = LBA }
			set_variable = { cwop_rank = 8 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = UAE }
			set_variable = { cwop_rank = 9 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = ALG }
			set_variable = { cwop_rank = 10 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { cwop_rank = global.num_days }
			add_to_variable = { cwop_rank = 100 }
		}
	}
	# year of accession shown in the members table
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cwop_acc } }
		if = {
			limit = { original_tag = PER }
			set_variable = { cwop_acc = 1960 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = IRQ }
			set_variable = { cwop_acc = 1960 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = KUW }
			set_variable = { cwop_acc = 1960 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = SAU }
			set_variable = { cwop_acc = 1960 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = VEN }
			set_variable = { cwop_acc = 1960 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = QAT }
			set_variable = { cwop_acc = 1961 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = IND }
			set_variable = { cwop_acc = 1962 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = LBA }
			set_variable = { cwop_acc = 1962 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = UAE }
			set_variable = { cwop_acc = 1967 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = ALG }
			set_variable = { cwop_acc = 1969 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { cwop_acc = global.num_days }
			subtract_from_variable = { cwop_acc = global.cwop_epoch }
			divide_variable = { cwop_acc = 365 }
			subtract_from_variable = { cwop_acc = 0.499 }
			round_variable = cwop_acc
			add_to_variable = { cwop_acc = 1970 }
		}
	}
	# temperament of the delegation (KI-Lite, design 5.3); countries without a line are neutral (0)
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = ALG }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_up = 35 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_down = -30 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_quota = 20 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_sov = 35 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_emb = 30 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_fund = 10 }
		set_variable = { cwop_kind = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = LBA }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_up = 40 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_down = -35 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_quota = 25 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_sov = 35 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_emb = 40 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_fund = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_kind = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = IRQ }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_up = 30 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_down = -25 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_quota = 10 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_sov = 35 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_emb = 35 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_fund = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_kind = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = PER }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_up = 30 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_down = -20 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_quota = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_sov = 20 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_emb = -40 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_fund = 5 }
		set_variable = { cwop_kind = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = VEN }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_up = 20 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_down = -15 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_quota = 15 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_sov = 25 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_emb = -40 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_fund = 10 }
		set_variable = { cwop_kind = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = IND }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_up = 5 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_down = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_quota = -10 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_sov = 10 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_emb = -30 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_fund = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_kind = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = KUW }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_up = 5 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_down = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_quota = 15 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_sov = 20 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_emb = 10 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_fund = 20 }
		set_variable = { cwop_kind = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = QAT }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_up = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_down = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_quota = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_sov = 10 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_emb = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_fund = 5 }
		set_variable = { cwop_kind = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = UAE }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_up = -10 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_down = 10 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_quota = -5 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_sov = 10 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_emb = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_fund = 10 }
		set_variable = { cwop_kind = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = SAU }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_up = -20 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_down = 20 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_quota = -15 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_sov = 10 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_emb = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_fund = 15 }
		set_variable = { cwop_kind = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = NIG }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_up = 15 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_down = -10 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_quota = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_sov = 20 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_emb = -20 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_fund = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_kind = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = ECU }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_up = 10 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_down = -5 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_quota = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_sov = 15 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_emb = -20 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_fund = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_kind = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = GAB }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_up = 5 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_down = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_quota = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_sov = 5 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_emb = -10 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_fund = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_kind = 2 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_up = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_down = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_quota = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_sov = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_emb = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_tp_fund = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwop_kind = 2 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Country with a status at OPEC or the OAPEC (read by the monthly check and the window).
COLDWAR_OPEC_watch = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_watch value = THIS } } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_watch = THIS }
	}
}

# Country scope. Status spirit, the status arrays and the OPEC modifier after every change of cwop_status.
COLDWAR_OPEC_set_status_idea = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_OPEC_member } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_OPEC_member }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_OPEC_associate } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_OPEC_associate }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_OPEC_observer } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_OPEC_observer }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_OPEC_suspended } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_OPEC_suspended }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_status = 5 } }
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_OPEC_member
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_status = 3 } }
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_OPEC_associate
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_status = 1 } }
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_OPEC_observer
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_status = 4 } }
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_OPEC_suspended
	}
	remove_from_array = { global.cwop_members = THIS }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwop_assoc = THIS }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwop_obs = THIS }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwop_susp = THIS }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_status = 5 } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_members = THIS }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_status = 3 } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_assoc = THIS }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_status = 1 } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_obs = THIS }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_status = 4 } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_susp = THIS }
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_set_country_data = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_watch = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_line } } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_line }
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_recount = yes
}

# Country scope. Full member (start, admission D1, reactivation after a suspension).
COLDWAR_OPEC_become_member = {
	log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: COLDWAR_OPEC_become_member ([THIS.GetName])"
	set_variable = { cwop_status = 5 }
	set_variable = { cwop_since = global.num_days }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_set_status_idea = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Associate member (D2).
COLDWAR_OPEC_become_associate = {
	set_variable = { cwop_status = 3 }
	set_variable = { cwop_since = global.num_days }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_set_status_idea = yes
}

# Country scope. Observer (D7); members and associates keep their status.
COLDWAR_OPEC_become_observer = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_status > 1 } } }
		set_variable = { cwop_status = 1 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_set_status_idea = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Leaves every OPEC obligation (withdrawal, suspension, loss of the country).
COLDWAR_OPEC_release_obligations = {
	# price and cut agreements, quotas, cuts, the swing role, Fund payments and the Khartoum payments end
	clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_price_agreement
	clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_price_cut
	clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_supply_restraint
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_basket
	remove_from_array = { global.cwop_quota = THIS }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwop_cutters = THIS }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwop_fund_payers = THIS }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwop_k_payers = THIS }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwop_noleak = THIS }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_swing = THIS.id } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_end_swing = yes
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_q_EX = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_c_EX = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_s_EX = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_l_EX = 0 }
	# its part in the joint embargoes ends (its bilateral embargoes stay its own decision)
	remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e1_src = THIS }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e2_src = THIS }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e3_src = THIS }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e4_src = THIS }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes
}

# Country scope. Leaves OPEC (Statute Art. 8: on the 1 January after the notice; readmission only by a new admission).
COLDWAR_OPEC_leave = {
	log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: COLDWAR_OPEC_leave ([THIS.GetName])"
	set_variable = { cwop_status = 0 }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_release_obligations = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_set_status_idea = yes
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_leaving
	remove_from_array = { global.cwop_cands = THIS }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand1 = THIS.id } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_cand1 = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand2 = THIS.id } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_cand2 = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand3 = THIS.id } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_cand3 = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand4 = THIS.id } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_cand4 = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_pres = THIS.id } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_pres = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_sg = THIS.id } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_vacate_sg = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_line } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_line }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Suspended membership (Ecuador 1992, Indonesia 2009): no vote, no obligations.
COLDWAR_OPEC_suspend = {
	log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: COLDWAR_OPEC_suspend ([THIS.GetName])"
	set_variable = { cwop_status = 4 }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_release_obligations = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_set_status_idea = yes
	remove_from_array = { global.cwop_cands = THIS }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand1 = THIS.id } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_cand1 = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand2 = THIS.id } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_cand2 = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand3 = THIS.id } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_cand3 = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand4 = THIS.id } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_cand4 = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_pres = THIS.id } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_pres = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_sg = THIS.id } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_vacate_sg = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Member of the OAPEC (Arab oil ministers).
COLDWAR_OPEC_join_oapec = {
	set_variable = { cwop_oapec = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_oapec value = THIS } } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_oapec = THIS }
	}
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_OPEC_oapec } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_OPEC_oapec }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_watch = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_set_country_data = yes
}

# Country scope. Leaves the OAPEC.
COLDWAR_OPEC_leave_oapec = {
	set_variable = { cwop_oapec = 0 }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwop_oapec = THIS }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_OPEC_oapec } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_OPEC_oapec }
}

# Any scope. Counts full members, seated players, founders and OAPEC members.
COLDWAR_OPEC_recount = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_n_full = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_n_players = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_n_ai = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_n_founders = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_n_oapec = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_n_oapec_players = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_n_assoc = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_n_obs = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_n_susp = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwop_n_full = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwop_n_players = 1 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { global.cwop_n_ai = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_founder = yes }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwop_n_founders = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_oapec
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwop_n_oapec = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwop_n_oapec_players = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwop_n_assoc = global.cwop_assoc^num }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_n_obs = global.cwop_obs^num }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_n_susp = global.cwop_susp^num }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Monthly: countries that vanished (annexation) leave every list; offices that pointed at them fall vacant.
COLDWAR_OPEC_check_members = {
	clear_temp_array = cwop_t_dead
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_watch
		if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = yes } } add_to_temp_array = { cwop_t_dead = THIS } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_dead^num > 0 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = cwop_t_dead
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_watch = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_members = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_assoc = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_obs = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_susp = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_oapec = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_quota = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_cutters = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_fund_payers = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_k_payers = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_cands = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_noleak = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e1_src = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e2_src = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e3_src = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e4_src = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e1_tg = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e2_tg = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e3_tg = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e4_tg = THIS }
			set_variable = { cwop_status = 0 }
			set_variable = { cwop_oapec = 0 }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_set_status_idea = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_pres > 0 }
				NOT = { var:global.cwop_pres = { exists = yes } } }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_pres = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_sg > 0 }
				NOT = { var:global.cwop_sg = { exists = yes } } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_vacate_sg = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_swing > 0 }
				NOT = { var:global.cwop_swing = { exists = yes } } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_end_swing = yes
		}
		COLDWAR_OPEC_recount = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Start of the 1970 scenario (on_startup) or bootstrap of an older save.
COLDWAR_OPEC_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_initialized } }
		log = "[GetDateText]: COLDWAR_OPEC_initialize (Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries)"
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_initialized
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.cwop_epoch } }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_epoch = global.num_days }
		}
		set_variable = { global.cwop_issue = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ticket = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_sess = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_pres = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_sg = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_swing = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_cut_stage = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_a3_next = 1.05 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_a7_next = 1.05 }
		# the ten members of 1970 (founders Iran, Iraq, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Venezuela) and the OAPEC
		if = { limit = { country_exists = PER } PER = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_founder COLDWAR_OPEC_become_member = yes set_variable = { cwop_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = IRQ } IRQ = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_founder COLDWAR_OPEC_become_member = yes set_variable = { cwop_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = KUW } KUW = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_founder COLDWAR_OPEC_become_member = yes set_variable = { cwop_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SAU } SAU = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_founder COLDWAR_OPEC_become_member = yes set_variable = { cwop_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = VEN } VEN = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_founder COLDWAR_OPEC_become_member = yes set_variable = { cwop_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = QAT } QAT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_become_member = yes set_variable = { cwop_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = IND } IND = { COLDWAR_OPEC_become_member = yes set_variable = { cwop_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = LBA } LBA = { COLDWAR_OPEC_become_member = yes set_variable = { cwop_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = UAE } UAE = { COLDWAR_OPEC_become_member = yes set_variable = { cwop_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ALG } ALG = { COLDWAR_OPEC_become_member = yes set_variable = { cwop_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = KUW } KUW = { COLDWAR_OPEC_join_oapec = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = LBA } LBA = { COLDWAR_OPEC_join_oapec = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SAU } SAU = { COLDWAR_OPEC_join_oapec = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ALG } ALG = { COLDWAR_OPEC_join_oapec = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = BHR } BHR = { COLDWAR_OPEC_join_oapec = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = QAT } QAT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_join_oapec = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = UAE } UAE = { COLDWAR_OPEC_join_oapec = yes } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_recount = yes
		# the first ordinary Conference sits on 1 June 1970; the office of the Secretary General opens for candidates
		COLDWAR_OPEC_next_session_day = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwop_sess_next = cwop_t_next }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_open_candidacy = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_market_sample = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_all = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Older 1970 saves start the system at the first monthly tick.
COLDWAR_OPEC_bootstrap = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_initialized }
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_bootstrap_epoch = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_initialize = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. A new President of the Conference at every Conference: the next player member in the order of accession.
COLDWAR_OPEC_rotate_president = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_pres > 0 }
			var:global.cwop_pres = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwop_pres = { if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_OPEC_presidency } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_OPEC_presidency } }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_cur = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_pres > 0 }
			var:global.cwop_pres = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwop_pres = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_cur = cwop_rank } }
	}
	# the next player member after the last President, in the order of accession; from the start again after the last
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_best = 999999999 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bestc = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_first = 999999999 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_firstc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_rank > cwop_t_cur }
						check_variable = { cwop_rank < cwop_t_best } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_best = cwop_rank }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bestc = THIS.id }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_rank < cwop_t_first } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_first = cwop_rank }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_firstc = THIS.id }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_bestc = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bestc = cwop_t_firstc }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwop_pres = cwop_t_bestc }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_pres > 0 } }
		var:global.cwop_pres = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_OPEC_presidency }
	}
	clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_pres_forward_used
}

# Any scope. The office of the Secretary General opens for candidates (30 days, 50 PP; four candidates at most).
COLDWAR_OPEC_open_candidacy = {
	clear_array = global.cwop_cands
	set_variable = { global.cwop_cand1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_cand2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_cand3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_cand4 = 0 }
	clear_array = global.cwop_sgcamp
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s9_phase = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s9_item = 90 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s9_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s9_due = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_s9_due = 30 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s9_len = 30 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s9_issue = global.cwop_issue }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_variable = { cwop_sgp1 = 0 }
			set_variable = { cwop_sgp2 = 0 }
			set_variable = { cwop_sgp3 = 0 }
			set_variable = { cwop_sgp4 = 0 }
			clear_array = cwop_lob9
			clear_array = cwop_pay9
			clear_array = cwop_prs9
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Country scope (player member). Stands for Secretary General.
COLDWAR_OPEC_stand_for_sg = {
	add_political_power = -50
	add_to_array = { global.cwop_cands = THIS }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand1 = 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand1 = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwop_cand2 = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwop_cand3 = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwop_cand4 = THIS.id } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_cand1 = THIS.id }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand2 = 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand1 = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwop_cand2 = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwop_cand3 = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwop_cand4 = THIS.id } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_cand2 = THIS.id }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand3 = 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand1 = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwop_cand2 = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwop_cand3 = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwop_cand4 = THIS.id } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_cand3 = THIS.id }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand4 = 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand1 = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwop_cand2 = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwop_cand3 = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwop_cand4 = THIS.id } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_cand4 = THIS.id }
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Candidacy closes: with candidates the Conference elects within 30 days; without any the office goes by rotation.
COLDWAR_OPEC_close_candidacy = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cands^num > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s9_phase = 2 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s9_since = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s9_due = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_s9_due = 30 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s9_len = 30 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_issue = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s9_issue = global.cwop_issue }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 90 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_target = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_members
			if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_item = cwop_t_eitem }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_res = cwop_t_eres }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_target = cwop_t_etarget }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 4 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_val = cwop_t_eval }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev1_busy } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev1_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_OPEC_rotate_sg = yes
	}
}

# Country scope (player member). Votes for candidate cwop_x_cand (country id).
COLDWAR_OPEC_sg_vote = {
	set_variable = { cwop_sgv = cwop_x_cand }
	set_variable = { cwop_sgvi = global.cwop_s9_issue }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. The election closes. Unanimous: the winner serves three years (renewable once). Otherwise: rotation, two years.
COLDWAR_OPEC_close_sg_vote = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_c1 = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_c2 = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_c3 = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_c4 = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_split = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bestsh = -999 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bestk = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand1 > 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_k = 1 }
					COLDWAR_OPEC_sg_stance = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_sh > cwop_t_bestsh } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bestsh = cwop_t_sh }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bestk = 1 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand2 > 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_k = 2 }
					COLDWAR_OPEC_sg_stance = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_sh > cwop_t_bestsh } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bestsh = cwop_t_sh }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bestk = 2 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand3 > 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_k = 3 }
					COLDWAR_OPEC_sg_stance = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_sh > cwop_t_bestsh } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bestsh = cwop_t_sh }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bestk = 3 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand4 > 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_k = 4 }
					COLDWAR_OPEC_sg_stance = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_sh > cwop_t_bestsh } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bestsh = cwop_t_sh }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bestk = 4 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_bestk = 1 } }
					add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_c1 = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_bestk = 2 } }
					add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_c2 = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_bestk = 3 } }
					add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_c3 = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_bestk = 4 } }
					add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_c4 = 1 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_sgvi = global.cwop_s9_issue } }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_sgv = global.cwop_cand1 } }
					add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_c1 = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_sgv = global.cwop_cand2 } }
					add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_c2 = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_sgv = global.cwop_cand3 } }
					add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_c3 = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_sgv = global.cwop_cand4 } }
					add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_c4 = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# the candidate with most votes (the earlier candidacy wins a tie)
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_win = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_wv = cwop_t_c1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_c2 > cwop_t_wv } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_win = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_wv = cwop_t_c2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_c3 > cwop_t_wv } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_win = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_wv = cwop_t_c3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_c4 > cwop_t_wv } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_win = 4 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_wv = cwop_t_c4 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_winner = global.cwop_cand1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_win = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_winner = global.cwop_cand2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_win = 3 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_winner = global.cwop_cand3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_win = 4 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_winner = global.cwop_cand4 }
	}
	# unanimity (Art. 28): every player voted for him (or did not vote) and no AI delegation is against him
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_k = cwop_t_win }
				COLDWAR_OPEC_sg_stance = yes
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_t_sh > -25 } } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_split = 1 }
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_sgvi = global.cwop_s9_issue }
						NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_sgv = cwop_t_winner } } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_split = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_split = 0 }
			var:cwop_t_winner = { exists = yes COLDWAR_OPEC_is_member = yes } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_term = 1095 }
		var:cwop_t_winner = { COLDWAR_OPEC_install_sg = yes }
	}
	else = {
		# no unanimity: the office goes by rotation for two years
		COLDWAR_OPEC_rotate_sg = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Becomes Secretary General for temp cwop_t_term days.
COLDWAR_OPEC_install_sg = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_sg > 0 }
			var:global.cwop_sg = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwop_sg = { if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_OPEC_secretary_general } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_OPEC_secretary_general } }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwop_sg = THIS.id }
	add_ideas = COLDWAR_OPEC_secretary_general
	set_variable = { global.cwop_sg_end = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_sg_end = cwop_t_term }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_sg_term = cwop_t_term }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_sg_terms = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_sg_rank = cwop_rank }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s9_phase = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s9_item = 0 }
	clear_array = global.cwop_cands
	set_variable = { global.cwop_cand1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_cand2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_cand3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_cand4 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_away_sg = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 90 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 9 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_target = THIS.id }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_members
		if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q4_item = cwop_t_eitem }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q4_res = cwop_t_eres }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q4_target = cwop_t_etarget }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = cwop_t_term }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q4_val = cwop_t_eval }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev4_busy } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev4_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.4 }
			}
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Rotation (Art. 28 without unanimity): the next player member in the order of accession serves two years.
COLDWAR_OPEC_rotate_sg = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_cur = global.cwop_sg_rank }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_best = 999999999 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bestc = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_first = 999999999 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_firstc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_rank > cwop_t_cur }
						check_variable = { cwop_rank < cwop_t_best } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_best = cwop_rank }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bestc = THIS.id }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_rank < cwop_t_first } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_first = cwop_rank }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_firstc = THIS.id }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_bestc = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bestc = cwop_t_firstc }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_bestc > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_term = 730 }
		var:cwop_t_bestc = { COLDWAR_OPEC_install_sg = yes }
	}
	else = {
		# no player member: the office stays vacant (the President leads the Secretariat) and opens again in 90 days
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s9_phase = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_sg = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_sg_end = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_sg_end = 90 }
	}
}

# Any scope. The office of the Secretary General falls vacant; candidacy opens.
COLDWAR_OPEC_vacate_sg = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_sg > 0 }
			var:global.cwop_sg = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwop_sg = { if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_OPEC_secretary_general } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_OPEC_secretary_general } }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwop_sg = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_sg_end = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_away_sg = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s9_phase > 0 } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_open_candidacy = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Weekly: candidacy and election deadlines, end of term, absent office holders.
COLDWAR_OPEC_offices_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s9_phase = 1 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_s9_due } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_close_candidacy = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s9_phase = 2 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_s9_due } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_close_sg_vote = yes
	}
	# end of term: a three-year Secretary General may stand once more; the office opens for candidates
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_sg_end > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_sg_end } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s9_phase > 0 } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_sg > 0 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_vacate_sg = yes
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_OPEC_open_candidacy = yes
		}
	}
	# a Secretary General governed by the AI for 90 days loses the office
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_sg > 0 }
			var:global.cwop_sg = { exists = yes is_ai = yes } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_away_sg = 7 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwop_away_sg = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwop_away_sg < 90 } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_vacate_sg = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_pres > 0 }
			var:global.cwop_pres = { exists = yes is_ai = yes }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_any_player_member = yes }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_rotate_president = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_pres = 0 }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_any_player_member = yes }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_rotate_president = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. The OPEC line modifier: permanent resolutions (cwop_m_*), quota (cwop_q_EX), cuts (cwop_c_EX), swing producer (cwop_s_EX), indirect-supply ban (cwop_l_EX).
COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = {
	set_variable = { cwop_dm_EX = cwop_m_EX }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_dm_EX = cwop_q_EX }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_dm_EX = cwop_c_EX }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_dm_EX = cwop_s_EX }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_dm_EX = cwop_l_EX }
	set_variable = { cwop_dm_HM = cwop_m_HM }
	set_variable = { cwop_dm_ST = cwop_m_ST }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwop_dm_EX min = -0.5 max = 0.5 }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

# Any scope. Refreshes every country with the OPEC modifier and the market values.
COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_all = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_watch
		if = { limit = { exists = yes has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_line } } COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes }
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_market_values = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Weekly: the Conference, the offices, the open files, notices of withdrawal; it reads at most nine files and never loops over the world.
COLDWAR_OPEC_weekly = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_session_tick = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_offices_tick = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_slots_tick = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_ai_office_tables = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_check_leavers = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_recount = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_touch = yes
}

# Any scope. Monthly: members, the price steps of resolutions in force, embargoes and payments, the market sample (one pass over the world for the crisis tiers).
COLDWAR_OPEC_monthly = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_check_members = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_monthly_price = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_tick = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_market_sample = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_calendar_now = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_doy < 31 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_yearly = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_all = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_touch = yes
}

# Any scope. Weekly in the first week of January: withdrawals and reactivations take effect (Statute Art. 8).
COLDWAR_OPEC_check_leavers = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_calendar_now = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_doy < 7 } }
		# Art. 8: notices of withdrawal take effect on 1 January; notices of reactivation too
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_leaving COLDWAR_OPEC_is_member = yes }
			for_each_scope_loop = { array = global.cwop_members if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = PREV } } add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_op_left } } }
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_rejoin_cooldown days = 365 value = 1 }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_leave = yes
		}
		every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_reactivating COLDWAR_OPEC_is_suspended = yes } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_reactivating COLDWAR_OPEC_become_member = yes }
	}
}
